(promoted via playoffs) | website = {{URL|https://fcvoluntari.ro/}} | current = 2026–27 FC Voluntari season | kit_alt1 = | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _nikepark8vb | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = | leftarm1 = 77BBFF | body1 = 77BBFF | rightarm1 = 77BBFF | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 77BBFF | kit_alt2 = | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _nikepark7jg | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = dbaf2d | body2 = dbaf2d | rightarm2 = dbaf2d | shorts2 = 000000 | socks2 = 000000 | kit_alt3 = | pattern_la3 = | pattern_b3 = | pattern_ra3 = | pattern_sh3 = | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} '''Fotbal Club Voluntari''' ({{IPA|ro|volunˈtarʲ}}), commonly known as '''FC Voluntari''' or simply '''Voluntari''', is a Romanian professional [[Association football|football]] [[Club (organization)|club]] based in [[Voluntari]], [[Ilfov County]], that competes in [[Liga I]], the first tier of the [[Romanian football league system|Romanian league system]]. The team plays its home matches at [[Stadionul Anghel Iordănescu|Anghel Iordănescu Stadium]], which has a capacity of 4,600 spectators. Founded in 2010, Voluntari achieved successive promotions from [[Liga III]] to [[Liga I]] in [[2013–14 Liga III|2014]] and [[2014–15 Liga II|2015]], becoming one of the few clubs in [[Romanian football]] to make this leap.{{cite web|url=https://liga2.prosport.ro/special/fc-voluntari-a-intrat-in-istoria-fotbalului-romanesc-doar-11-echipe-se-pot-lauda-cu-o-astfel-de-performanta-14321158|title=FC Voluntari a intrat în istoria fotbalului românesc|language=ro|trans-title=FC Voluntari entered the history of Romanian football|date=23 May 2015|accessdate=22 May 2026|publisher=liga2.prosport.ro|archive-date=22 May 2026|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260522094157/https://liga2.prosport.ro/special/fc-voluntari-a-intrat-in-istoria-fotbalului-romanesc-doar-11-echipe-se-pot-lauda-cu-o-astfel-de-performanta-14321158|url-status=live}} The club spent nine consecutive seasons in [[Liga I|Romania's top flight]] between [[2015–16 Liga I|2015]] and [[2023–24 Liga I|2024]]. It won its first major trophies in 2017, lifting both the [[2016–17 Cupa României|Cupa României]] and the [[2017 Supercupa României|Supercupa României]]."}}
